g-01.enunciado:
A municipal savings bank stores its daily transactions as Parquet files in cloud storage. Internal audit requires the data engineering team to see what changed in each load, who ran it, and when; to query the table as it was at the previous month-end close; and to ensure no reader ever sees a partially written load. The data must stay in its current location.

Which change meets these requirements?
opciones: Convert the files to Delta Lake with CONVERT TO DELTA and register the table in Unity Catalog
Keep the Parquet files and save a full dated copy of the folder every night
Enable object versioning on the bucket and read previous object versions with spark.read
Create a temporary view for each month-end close on top of the Parquet files

g-02.enunciado:
A data engineer must incrementally ingest JSON files that land continuously in an S3 bucket. Each run must process only the files that have arrived since the previous run.

Which approach should the data engineer use?
opciones: spark.read.format("json").load(ruta) scheduled to run every hour
spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles").option("cloudFiles.format", "json").load(ruta)
spark.readStream.format("delta").load(ruta)
dbutils.fs.cp(ruta, destino, recurse=True) followed by an INSERT INTO

g-03.enunciado:
A data engineer schedules a COPY INTO command to run every hour against the same source folder. Some files in the folder were already loaded by a previous run.

How does COPY INTO handle those files?
opciones: It loads them again, creating duplicate rows in the target table
It skips them, because COPY INTO tracks which files have already been loaded
It fails with a duplicate-file error and loads nothing
It deletes them from the source folder after the first load

g-04.enunciado:
The sales operations team needs Salesforce objects such as accounts and opportunities to be kept incrementally up to date in Unity Catalog tables. The data engineering team wants to write as little code as possible and avoid maintaining the extraction logic.

Which ingestion option should the data engineer recommend?
opciones: A notebook that calls the Salesforce API, scheduled nightly with Lakeflow Jobs
Exporting Salesforce reports to CSV and loading them manually with COPY INTO
A Lakeflow Connect managed connector for Salesforce
Auto Loader pointed directly at the Salesforce API endpoint

g-05.enunciado:
A data engineer receives a batch of customer records. Some customers already exist in the target Delta table and must be updated; the rest are new and must be inserted.

Which Delta Lake command accomplishes this in a single atomic operation?
opciones: INSERT OVERWRITE
MERGE INTO
UPDATE ... FROM
COPY INTO

g-06.enunciado:
A data engineer has two DataFrames with the same schema, df_lima and df_arequipa, that share some identical rows. The data engineer runs df_lima.union(df_arequipa) in PySpark.

What happens to the rows that appear in both DataFrames?
opciones: They are removed automatically, as with UNION in SQL
They are kept, because DataFrame union() behaves like UNION ALL
The operation fails because the input contains duplicate rows
Only the rows from df_arequipa are kept

g-07.enunciado:
A data engineer is building a Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines pipeline (formerly Delta Live Tables). Records with a null id must be dropped from the target dataset without stopping the pipeline update.

Which constraint should the data engineer define?
opciones: CONSTRAINT id_valido EXPECT (id IS NOT NULL)
CONSTRAINT id_valido EXPECT (id IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION DROP ROW
CONSTRAINT id_valido EXPECT (id IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE
CONSTRAINT id_valido CHECK (id IS NOT NULL)

g-08.enunciado:
A Lakeflow Jobs job with five tasks failed at task 4. After fixing the issue, the data engineer wants to rerun only the failed task and its dependents, without rerunning the tasks that already succeeded.

Which feature should the data engineer use?
opciones: Run now on the entire job
Clone the job and delete the tasks that succeeded
Repair run
Change the job trigger to continuous

g-09.enunciado:
An external vendor drops files into a Unity Catalog volume at unpredictable times. The load job must start as soon as a new file arrives, without keeping compute running while it waits.

Which trigger type should the data engineer configure?
opciones: A schedule that runs every minute
A file arrival trigger
A continuous trigger
A notebook that loops and checks the folder every 30 seconds

g-10.enunciado:
A data engineer works in a Databricks Git folder connected to the team's repository. They need to develop a new feature without affecting the main branch that production uses.

What should the data engineer do?
opciones: Duplicate the notebook under a different name on the main branch
Create a new branch from the Git folder, then commit and push the changes to that branch
Edit main directly and notify the team before pushing
Export the notebook as a .dbc file and work outside the repository

g-11.enunciado:
A data engineering team wants to promote the same job and pipeline code across dev, test, and prod, changing only environment-specific settings such as the target catalog.

Which tool should the team use?
opciones: Manually recreate the jobs in each workspace
Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles) with targets and variables
Notebook widgets where the environment is typed in by hand on each run
A different cluster policy for each environment

g-12.enunciado:
A data engineer at a retail chain joins the sales table with the stores table on `tienda_id`. The online store accounts for 70% of all sales, and the other 300 stores share the rest. Adaptive query execution is disabled.

Which pattern should the data engineer expect to see for the join stage in the Spark UI?
opciones: Most tasks finish quickly, but one task runs far longer and its shuffle read is many times the median
All tasks take a similar amount of time, but nearly all of them report high Spill (Disk)
The stage has a single task, because Spark cannot split the sales table
Hundreds of very short tasks that spend more time being scheduled than processing data

g-13.enunciado:
An insurance company's claims table is frequently filtered by cliente_id and by date, and query patterns change over time. The data engineer wants to improve query performance without choosing and maintaining a partitioning scheme.

Which approach should the data engineer recommend?
opciones: Partition the table by cliente_id
Enable Liquid Clustering with CLUSTER BY (cliente_id, fecha)
Run ZORDER BY on every column every hour
Convert the table to CSV format for faster reads

g-14.enunciado:
The `analistas` group needs to query the `seguros.silver.polizas` table in Unity Catalog.

What is the minimum set of privileges the group requires?
opciones: SELECT on the table only
USE CATALOG on seguros, USE SCHEMA on seguros.silver, and SELECT on the table
ALL PRIVILEGES on the seguros catalog
MODIFY on the table and USE SCHEMA on seguros.silver

g-15.enunciado:
A data engineer runs DROP TABLE on an external table registered in Unity Catalog.

What happens to the table's underlying data files?
opciones: They are deleted immediately along with the metadata
They are deleted after 7 days
They remain in the external location; only the table definition is removed
They are moved to a recycle bin in the catalog

pla-01.enunciado:
A data engineer runs VACUUM on a Delta table using the default retention period. Later, an analyst tries to time travel to the version of the table from 10 days ago.

What is the most likely outcome?
opciones: The query succeeds, because time travel does not depend on VACUUM
The query fails, because VACUUM removed unreferenced data files older than 7 days that this version needed
The query succeeds, because VACUUM only removes the transaction log
The query fails, because VACUUM deletes the entire version history of the table

pla-02.enunciado:
An analyst accidentally deleted rows from a Delta table. Before restoring it, the data engineer wants to inspect the table as it was at version 12.

Which query should the data engineer run?
opciones: SELECT * FROM ventas VERSION AS OF 12
SELECT * FROM ventas@history(12)
RESTORE ventas SELECT VERSION 12
SELECT * FROM ventas WHERE _version = 12

pla-03.enunciado:
A data engineering team wants to run notebooks and jobs that start in seconds, without managing instance types, runtime versions, or cluster scaling.

Which compute option meets these requirements, and who manages the underlying infrastructure?
opciones: Serverless compute, where Databricks provisions and manages the resources
A fixed-size all-purpose cluster, which Databricks shuts down automatically when work finishes
A single node cluster, where the team manages scaling manually
A classic SQL warehouse, which runs only Python notebooks

pla-04.enunciado:
The BI team at an insurance company publishes dashboards that are used mostly between 8:00 and 10:00 a.m. and rarely during the rest of the day. The first query of the morning must return in seconds, compute must not stay running while idle, and the team does not want to manage clusters.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: A classic SQL warehouse configured to auto stop after 10 minutes of inactivity
A serverless SQL warehouse with auto stop enabled
An all-purpose cluster that stays on all day and is shared by the dashboards
A jobs cluster scheduled at 7:55 a.m. that runs the dashboard queries

pla-05.enunciado:
A data engineer runs `CREATE TABLE clientes (id INT, nombre STRING)` in Databricks without a USING clause.

In which format is the table created?
opciones: Parquet
Hive
Delta
CSV

pla-06.enunciado: In Unity Catalog, how should a data engineer reference a table by its fully qualified name?
opciones: schema.table
metastore.catalog.schema.table
catalog.schema.table
workspace.schema.table

pla-07.enunciado:
The security team at a bank in Lima requires that the virtual machines processing customer data run inside the bank's own cloud account network, where its firewall rules apply, and that the data remain in the bank's storage. Databricks may continue to operate the web application and the job scheduler.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Use serverless compute, because its resources are created inside the customer's cloud account network
Move the control plane into the bank's account, because notebook data is processed there
Use classic compute, because its compute plane runs in the customer's cloud account
Use any compute type, because all Databricks resources run in the customer's cloud account

pla-08.enunciado:
A retail chain runs its nightly PySpark ETL on an all-purpose cluster that stays on all day. The data engineering team wants to reduce cost and isolate each run, but every node must run an init script that installs the corporate monitoring agent.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Keep the all-purpose cluster and reduce its auto-termination to 10 minutes of inactivity
Use a classic jobs cluster with the init script, created for each run and terminated when it finishes
Run the job on serverless compute for jobs and register the init script in the environment settings
Run the PySpark notebook on a classic SQL warehouse with the init script configured

pla-09.enunciado:
A data scientist at an insurance company needs an all-purpose cluster for her own use. Her legacy code relies on the RDD API, requires Databricks Runtime for Machine Learning, and must read Unity Catalog tables.

Which compute configuration meets these requirements?
opciones: An all-purpose cluster in standard access mode, shared with the rest of the team
Serverless compute for notebooks, to avoid managing infrastructure
A cluster in No isolation shared mode, which applies no language restrictions
An all-purpose cluster in dedicated access mode assigned to her

pla-10.enunciado:
The finance team at a telecom company reviews the monthly bill for its pro SQL warehouse and sees two charges: one from Databricks and one from the cloud provider. The team is evaluating a move to a serverless SQL warehouse.

Which statement correctly describes how the cost model changes?
opciones: With serverless, the DBU rate includes the compute, so the virtual machines are not billed separately
With serverless, the virtual machines are still billed separately by the cloud provider, but there is no DBU charge
With serverless, the warehouse is billed a fixed monthly fee regardless of how long it runs
The cost model is identical for pro and serverless; only the startup time differs

pla-11.enunciado:
At a fintech, a job rewrites the Delta table `riesgo.scores_clientes` every hour while a dashboard queries it. The BI team requires that the dashboard never read partially written data: it must see either the complete previous version or the complete new version.

Which mechanism guarantees this behavior?
opciones: Unity Catalog locks the table for reads for the duration of the job's write
Parquet files are written atomically, so the file format alone guarantees it
The Delta Lake transaction log, which only exposes committed table versions
The Photon engine retries the dashboard query until the write completes

pla-12.enunciado:
A retail company has three workspaces (dev, qa, and prod) in the same cloud region. The platform team wants to define permissions once, centralize lineage and auditing, and use the same catalogs from all three workspaces.

Which approach meets these requirements?
opciones: Keep each workspace's Hive metastore and replicate the GRANT statements with a script in each one
Create one Unity Catalog metastore for the region and assign it to all three workspaces
Create a separate Unity Catalog metastore per workspace and synchronize permissions between them
Enable table access control on the clusters of each workspace separately

pla-13.enunciado:
An insurance company appends new policies to the Delta table `polizas` every night. Today, the source DataFrame contains an extra column, `canal_venta`, that does not exist in the table, and the write does not set any schema evolution option.

What happens when the write runs?
opciones: The write succeeds and `canal_venta` is added to the table automatically
The write succeeds, but the `canal_venta` values are silently dropped
The table is overwritten with the new schema and the existing policies are lost
The write fails because of schema enforcement, and the table remains unchanged

pla-14.enunciado:
A bank runs 40 small jobs that are triggered by file arrival throughout the day. Each job processes its data in about 3 minutes but first waits several minutes for its jobs cluster to start. The team wants to remove that wait without managing instance types or paying for idle machines.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Run the jobs on serverless compute for jobs, which starts quickly and bills only for usage
Create an instance pool that keeps several idle instances available for the jobs clusters
Use a single always-on all-purpose cluster shared by the 40 jobs
Schedule the jobs with a cron expression every 5 minutes instead of the file arrival trigger

ing-01.enunciado:
A data engineer configures Auto Loader with schema inference.

What is the purpose of the `cloudFiles.schemaLocation` option?
opciones: It defines where the output data is written
It specifies the path of the source files
It stores the inferred schema and tracks its evolution across runs
It replaces the checkpoint location of the stream

ing-02.enunciado: What is the purpose of `checkpointLocation` in a Structured Streaming query that writes to a Delta table?
opciones: It stores progress and state so the stream can recover after a failure without losing or duplicating data
It stores a backup copy of the target table
It defines how often a micro-batch runs
It stores the records rejected by data quality checks

ing-03.enunciado:
A data engineer wants an Auto Loader stream to behave like a scheduled batch job: process everything that is pending and then stop so that it does not consume compute.

Which trigger should the data engineer use?
opciones: trigger(processingTime="0 seconds")
trigger(continuous="1 second")
trigger(availableNow=True)
No trigger, because the stream stops on its own when there is no new data

ing-04.enunciado:
An Auto Loader stream uses the default schema evolution mode (addNewColumns). A file arrives that contains a new column.

What happens?
opciones: The new column is silently ignored
The stream stops, updates the stored schema, and includes the new column after it restarts
The column values go to _rescued_data and the schema never changes
A new table with the additional column is created automatically

ing-05.enunciado:
A bronze table has a schema agreed with the business that must not change. However, the data engineer does not want the stream to stop or to lose data when a file contains unexpected columns.

Which Auto Loader schema evolution mode should the data engineer use?
opciones: addNewColumns
failOnNewColumns
rescue
none, without a rescued data column

ing-06.enunciado:
Auto Loader ingests from a directory that already contains millions of files, and listing the directory on every run has become slow and expensive.

Which change reduces this cost?
opciones: Switch from directory listing to file notification mode (file events)
Run the directory listing more frequently
Replace Auto Loader with spark.read.json over the entire folder
Reduce cloudFiles.maxFilesPerTrigger to 1

ing-07.enunciado:
Auto Loader infers the `monto` column of a set of CSV files as STRING. The data engineer needs it to be DECIMAL(12,2) without declaring the full schema of all 40 columns.

Which option should the data engineer use?
opciones: cloudFiles.schemaHints = "monto DECIMAL(12,2)"
cloudFiles.inferColumnTypes = false
mergeSchema = true on the write
Rename the column in the source files

ing-08.enunciado:
A vendor's new files contain an additional column, and a COPY INTO command into a Delta table now fails with a schema mismatch.

How can the data engineer allow the new column to be added to the target table?
opciones: COPY_OPTIONS ('mergeSchema' = 'true')
COPY_OPTIONS ('force' = 'true')
Run VACUUM before COPY INTO
Change FILEFORMAT to TEXT

ing-09.enunciado:
An upstream system writes thousands of files per hour to a bucket, and the volume will grow to millions of files. The data engineer needs reliable incremental ingestion into a Unity Catalog table.

Which option should the data engineer recommend?
opciones: COPY INTO scheduled every 5 minutes
Auto Loader
spark.read over the entire folder with mode("overwrite")
Manually uploading the files through the UI

ing-10.enunciado:
A data engineer needs to read a table from the company's PostgreSQL database in a notebook without exposing the password in the code.

Which approach should the data engineer use?
opciones: spark.read.format("jdbc") with the password retrieved through dbutils.secrets.get(scope, key)
Typing the password into a notebook widget
Storing the password in a hidden Markdown cell
Exporting the table to CSV and uploading it to the workspace

ing-11.enunciado:
A data engineer must incrementally replicate tables from an operational SQL Server database into Unity Catalog tables with low latency, without writing or maintaining extraction code.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Auto Loader pointed at the SQL Server database
A Lakeflow Connect managed connector for SQL Server
COPY INTO with a JDBC connection string
A daily CSV export followed by a manual load

ing-12.enunciado:
An exchange-rate provider exposes a proprietary REST API for which no connector exists. The data engineer needs to load the data into Unity Catalog once a day.

Which approach is appropriate?
opciones: Auto Loader with the API URL as the source path
Delta Sharing with the provider
A notebook that calls the API with a REST client and writes to a Unity Catalog table or volume, scheduled with Lakeflow Jobs
A Lakeflow Connect managed connector configured with the API URL

ing-13.enunciado:
The `payload` column is a STRUCT that contains cliente → direccion → ciudad.

Which Spark SQL expression selects the city?
opciones: SELECT payload.cliente.direccion.ciudad FROM eventos
SELECT payload->cliente->direccion->ciudad FROM eventos
SELECT explode(payload).ciudad FROM eventos
SELECT get_json_object(payload, 'ciudad') FROM eventos

ing-14.enunciado:
The `raw` column is a STRING that contains JSON documents. In Databricks SQL, the data engineer wants to extract the nested field cliente.ciudad without defining a schema.

Which syntax should the data engineer use?
opciones: SELECT raw.cliente.ciudad FROM bronze_eventos
SELECT raw:cliente.ciudad FROM bronze_eventos
SELECT explode(raw) FROM bronze_eventos
SELECT raw['cliente.ciudad'] FROM bronze_eventos

ing-15.enunciado:
A data engineer wants to explore, from SQL, a set of CSV files with a header row stored in a volume, without creating a table.

Which query is valid in Databricks?
opciones: SELECT * FROM read_files('/Volumes/raw/proveedores/tasas/', format => 'csv', header => true)
SELECT * FROM '/Volumes/raw/proveedores/tasas/' FORMAT CSV
LOAD CSV '/Volumes/raw/proveedores/tasas/' WITH HEADER
SELECT * FROM csv_table('/Volumes/raw/proveedores/tasas/')

ing-16.enunciado:
A data engineer needs a location governed by Unity Catalog to store raw files, such as policy PDFs and vendor CSVs, with permissions and lineage before they are processed.

What should the data engineer use?
opciones: The driver's local disk (/tmp)
The DBFS root
A Unity Catalog volume (/Volumes/catalog/schema/volume)
A temporary view

ing-17.enunciado:
A telecom operator in Chile receives top-up events as JSON files that arrive continuously in a bucket. The fraud team requires that each event reach the bronze table in under a minute, that each file be processed exactly once, and that restarts not duplicate data.

Which ingestion pattern meets these requirements?
opciones: A daily batch job with spark.read that fully overwrites the bronze top-ups table
A continuous Auto Loader stream with trigger(processingTime="30 seconds") and a checkpoint
An Auto Loader stream with trigger(availableNow=True) scheduled once a day with Lakeflow Jobs
A COPY INTO command scheduled every hour with Lakeflow Jobs on the top-ups folder

ing-18.enunciado:
A risk analyst at an insurance company has a 40 MB CSV file of rate tables on her laptop that changes twice a year. She needs a Unity Catalog governed table created within minutes, without writing code or configuring pipelines.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Configure a Lakeflow Connect managed connector that points to the folder on her laptop
Upload the file to the DBFS FileStore folder and query it with its dbfs:/ path
Create an Auto Loader stream in file notification mode on her local folder
Use Add data → Create or modify table to create a managed Delta table in Unity Catalog

ing-19.enunciado:
A bank will use the Lakeflow Connect managed connector for SQL Server to incrementally replicate its accounts tables into Unity Catalog. The DBA asks what must be prepared on the source database so the connector can capture inserts, updates, and deletes.

What should the data engineer tell the DBA?
opciones: Enable change tracking or change data capture (CDC) on the database and on the tables to be ingested
Export the tables to CSV files in a staging bucket every night for the connector to read
Add a modification timestamp column to each table and maintain it with triggers
Enable Delta Lake Change Data Feed (CDF) on the SQL Server tables

ing-20.enunciado:
A retail chain configures a Lakeflow Connect managed connector for the SQL Server database behind its ERP. The architect asks which component runs continuously to extract the initial snapshots and the ongoing changes and land them in a Unity Catalog staging location before they are applied to the target tables.

Which component is it?
opciones: The ingestion pipeline, which runs on serverless compute according to its schedule
An Auto Loader stream that reads the SQL Server transaction logs
The ingestion gateway
The Unity Catalog connection that stores the database credentials

ing-21.enunciado:
An insurance company will configure a Lakeflow Connect managed connector for Salesforce. Security requires that the OAuth credentials never appear in notebooks, that they be a governed object with their own permissions, and that they be reusable across multiple ingestion pipelines.

Where should the credentials be registered?
opciones: In a Unity Catalog storage credential associated with the Salesforce account
In a Unity Catalog connection, on which privileges such as USE CONNECTION are granted
In a Unity Catalog external location that points to the Salesforce URL
In environment variables of the cluster that runs the ingestion pipeline

ing-22.enunciado:
The compliance team at a bank in Colombia ingests Salesforce objects with a Lakeflow Connect managed connector. The target table currently keeps only the latest value of each account, but the team must now permanently retain every previous version of each record with its validity range, without writing additional code.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Enable history tracking (SCD type 2) in the connector's settings for those tables
Query previous versions with Delta time travel (VERSION AS OF) on the target table
Write a notebook that runs a daily MERGE to copy changes into a history table
Clone the target table every night with CREATE TABLE ... SHALLOW CLONE

ing-23.enunciado:
A fintech in Mexico publishes its digital wallet transactions to an Apache Kafka cluster. The data engineering team needs latency of seconds, must apply its own transformations before writing, and must land the data in tables governed by Unity Catalog.

Which ingestion method should the data engineer choose?
opciones: Auto Loader with cloudFiles.format = "kafka" pointed at the transactions topic
COPY INTO with the topic name as the source and FILEFORMAT = JSON
A Lakeflow Connect managed connector with an ingestion gateway connected to the Kafka cluster
Structured Streaming with the kafka source (standard connector) writing to a Delta table or streaming table

ing-24.enunciado:
A pharmacy chain uses a niche SaaS loyalty platform for which Lakeflow Connect offers no managed connector. The marketing team has no developers and wants a vendor-supported, no-code tool that lands the data in Unity Catalog tables.

Which option best meets these requirements?
opciones: Auto Loader with the SaaS platform's URL as the source file path
A notebook using the requests library, maintained by the marketing team
A partner ingestion tool, available through Partner Connect, that supports this source
Lakehouse Federation to query the SaaS platform live

ing-25.enunciado:
An insurance team corrected the bronze claims table by deleting the March records, which were wrong. The team now needs to reload the March source files, which COPY INTO had already loaded.

How can the data engineer reload these files with COPY INTO?
opciones: Add COPY_OPTIONS ('force' = 'true') and restrict the load to the March files with PATTERN or FILES
Add FORMAT_OPTIONS ('mergeSchema' = 'true') so the files are read again
Run the same COPY INTO command twice in a row on the March folder
Do nothing, because COPY INTO detects deleted rows and reloads their source files

ing-26.enunciado:
An insurance broker sends CSV files that use a semicolon (;) as the delimiter and include a header row.

Which clause completes the command so that the files load correctly into the Unity Catalog table?
opciones: COPY_OPTIONS ('header' = 'true', 'delimiter' = ';')
FORMAT_OPTIONS ('header' = 'true', 'delimiter' = ';')
FORMAT_OPTIONS ('header' = 'true') COPY_OPTIONS ('delimiter' = ';')
OPTIONS ('header' = 'true', 'delimiter' = ';')

ing-27.enunciado:
A bank has the managed table finanzas.bronze.transferencias in Unity Catalog and wants to load it with COPY INTO from s3://banco-landing/transferencias/. Policy prohibits access keys in code and DBFS mounts.

Which configuration allows the data engineer to run COPY INTO in a governed way?
opciones: Mount the bucket with dbutils.fs.mount and read from the /mnt/transferencias path
Pass temporary keys in the WITH (CREDENTIAL ...) clause of the command
An external location covering the path, with READ FILES granted to the engineer and MODIFY on the table
Grant SELECT on the bronze schema so that Unity Catalog infers the required access

ing-28.enunciado:
An ADLS folder contains pagos_*.json files, .ctl control files, and other JSON files from different sources. The data engineer needs COPY INTO to load only the files whose names start with pagos_ and end with .json.

Which clause completes the command?
opciones: FILTER = 'pagos_*.json'
FILES = ('pagos_*.json')
COPY_OPTIONS ('pattern' = 'pagos_*.json')
PATTERN = 'pagos_*.json'

ing-29.enunciado:
An insurance company receives claim photos and PDFs in a volume. The data engineering team needs a Delta table with each file's path, modification time, size, and binary content, ingested incrementally so it can be processed later with AI.

Which value completes the code?
opciones: "binaryFile"
"text"
"pdf"
"json"

ing-30.enunciado:
The Auto Loader stream shown declares its schema explicitly and does not set cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode. A file arrives with a new column, canal_venta.

What happens?
opciones: The stream fails and, after a restart, automatically adds canal_venta to the schema
The stream continues and canal_venta is ignored, because with an explicit schema the default mode is none
canal_venta is added to the table automatically without stopping the stream
Auto Loader discards the entire file and moves it to a bad-records folder

ing-31.enunciado:
A retailer in Peru ingests sales JSON with Auto Loader, schema inference, and the hint cloudFiles.schemaHints = "cantidad BIGINT". Some files from one store contain values such as "12 unid" in cantidad. The stream must not fail, those values must not be lost, and the team must be able to find them later.

Where do those values end up?
opciones: In the cantidad column, which Auto Loader automatically converts to STRING
In a quarantine table that Auto Loader creates next to the target table
In the driver log, because Auto Loader drops the entire row that caused the error
In the _rescued_data column, as JSON with the original value, while cantidad is set to null

ing-32.enunciado:
The governance team at an insurance company requires that every schema change be reviewed before it reaches bronze. If a file contains a new column, the Auto Loader stream must stop and must not evolve the schema on its own when it restarts.

Which value of cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode meets this requirement?
opciones: rescue
addNewColumns
failOnNewColumns
none

ing-33.enunciado:
A savings cooperative receives about 200 files a day in an ADLS container. The job's identity can only list and read the container, and the security policy prohibits creating cloud queues or event subscriptions.

Which Auto Loader configuration meets these requirements?
opciones: Directory listing mode, which is the default mode
File notification mode with cloudFiles.useNotifications = true
Replace Auto Loader with a file arrival trigger that has no checkpoint
None, because Auto Loader always requires a cloud event queue

ing-34.enunciado:
A telecom team ingests data-usage JSON files with Auto Loader and cloudFiles.schemaLocation. In the bronze table, every column, including megas_usados and es_roaming, was created as STRING. The team wants Auto Loader to infer the actual data types without writing out the full schema.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: .option("mergeSchema", "true") on the read
.option("cloudFiles.inferColumnTypes", "true")
.option("cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode", "addNewColumns")
.option("cloudFiles.format", "parquet")

ing-35.enunciado:
In a Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines pipeline written in SQL, a data engineer needs to ingest JSON files from a volume into a bronze table incrementally, processing only new files with Auto Loader.

Which pair of values fills the two blanks?
opciones: MATERIALIZED VIEW / read_files
STREAMING TABLE / read_files (without STREAM)
STREAMING TABLE / STREAM read_files
VIEW / STREAM read_files

ing-36.enunciado:

opciones: Retries on the task, with an interval between attempts
A manual repair run every morning
A 24-hour timeout on the job
An all-purpose cluster for the job

job-07.enunciado:
The job that builds the gold tables must run every time another team updates the silver.siniestros table, which happens at varying times.

Which trigger should the data engineer use?
opciones: A schedule that runs every hour
A table update trigger on silver.siniestros
A file arrival trigger on the table's internal storage path
A continuous trigger

job-08.enunciado:
A report for the financial regulator must be generated every business day at 6:00 a.m., regardless of when the data arrived.

Which trigger type is appropriate?
opciones: A scheduled trigger with a cron expression
A file arrival trigger
A table update trigger
A continuous trigger

job-09.enunciado:
A process has three steps: a declarative pipeline that ingests data, a notebook that validates the results, and the refresh of a SQL dashboard. Each step depends on the previous one.

What is the best way to orchestrate this process?
opciones: A single job with pipeline, notebook, and dashboard tasks chained by dependencies in the DAG
Three separate jobs scheduled 30 minutes apart
A notebook that calls the other two with dbutils.notebook.run
Run each step manually and notify the team by email

job-10.enunciado:
A job scheduled every 10 minutes sometimes takes 15 minutes, and two overlapping runs produce duplicate data.

Which setting prevents this?
opciones: Set the job's maximum concurrent runs to 1
Increase the number of task retries
Switch to a file arrival trigger
Double the size of the cluster

job-11.enunciado:
The same load job must run for either the 'vida' (life) or the 'vehicular' (auto) line of business, depending on who triggers it, without duplicating the job.

What should the data engineer use?
opciones: Job parameters with a default value, referenced by the tasks
Two copies of the job with the value hardcoded
A global Python variable defined in the notebook
A separate trigger per line of business on the same job

job-12.enunciado:
A production job currently runs as the engineer who created it, and that engineer is leaving the company.

Which change follows best practice?
opciones: Configure the job to run as a service principal that has the required permissions
Share the engineer's password with the team
Grant ALL PRIVILEGES on the job to all users
Recreate the job whenever someone leaves the company

job-13.enunciado:
A telecom operator in Colombia has a job with 5 tasks. Only the `consultar_api_tarifas` task occasionally fails, because the provider returns HTTP 429 (rate limit exceeded), which clears in about 10 minutes. The transformation tasks are expensive and must not be retried automatically.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Enable the continuous trigger so the job relaunches whenever a run ends with an error
Schedule the job every 10 minutes with a cron expression and limit concurrent runs to 1 so the next run covers the failure
Configure a retry policy only on `consultar_api_tarifas`, with up to 3 retries and a minimum interval of 10 minutes
Run a repair run from the UI whenever the job fails, because retries apply to every task in the job

job-14.enunciado:
At a Peruvian bank, the `conciliar_cuentas` task sometimes hangs while waiting for an external resource and keeps compute running for hours. The task must be canceled if it runs longer than 2 hours and, in that case, retried exactly once.

Which task configuration (Jobs API format) meets both requirements?
opciones: "timeout_seconds": 7200, "max_retries": 1, "retry_on_timeout": true
"timeout_seconds": 7200, "max_retries": 1, "retry_on_timeout": false
"timeout_seconds": 120, "max_retries": 1, "retry_on_timeout": true
"max_retries": 1 and a RUN_DURATION_SECONDS health rule greater than 7200

job-15.enunciado:
A Chilean insurer's job creates temporary tables in `staging` at the start, and its final task, `limpiar_staging`, drops them. The cleanup must always run once its upstream tasks finish, whether they succeeded or any of them failed.

Which "Run if" condition on `limpiar_staging` meets this requirement?
opciones: All succeeded
At least one failed
None failed
All done

job-16.enunciado:
A retail chain in Mexico loads sales from two independent sources: `ingesta_tiendas` and `ingesta_ecommerce`. The `consolidar_ventas` task depends on both and must run if at least one load succeeded, publishing whatever is available, but must not run if both failed.

Which "Run if" condition meets this requirement?
opciones: All done
At least one succeeded
None failed
All succeeded

job-17.enunciado:
A job at a finance company in Ecuador receives the job parameter `tipo_carga`. If its value is "completa", the `recarga_historica` task must run; otherwise, the `carga_incremental` task must run. The team wants the selected branch to be visible in the job graph and does not want to maintain two jobs.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: An If/else condition task that compares {{job.parameters.tipo_carga}} to "completa" and branches on true or false
An initial notebook with a Python if statement that calls one notebook or the other with dbutils.notebook.run
Two separate jobs, one per load type, each with its own schedule and a fixed parameter value
Set the "Run if" condition At least one succeeded on both tasks so that Lakeflow Jobs chooses which one runs

job-18.enunciado:
An insurer defines, in a Declarative Automation Bundle, a For each task that runs the same notebook for each country.

Which value belongs in the blank so that each iteration receives its own country?
opciones: "{{job.parameters.pais}}"
"${var.pais}"
"{{input}}"
"{{tasks.cierre_por_pais.values.pais}}"

job-19.enunciado:
At a pharmacy chain, the list of branches to process changes every day. The `listar_sucursales` task reads it from a control table, and the following For each task must iterate over it without anyone editing the job each day.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Write the list to a text file in a volume and set the For each inputs to that file's path
Define a job parameter `sucursales` and update its default value from the UI every morning
Store the list in a global Python variable, because the job's tasks share the same Spark session
Publish the list with dbutils.jobs.taskValues.set() and use {{tasks.listar_sucursales.values.sucursales}} as the input

job-20.enunciado:
A bank's job has four tasks: `extraer` → `transformar` → `publicar`, plus `archivar`, which depends only on `extraer`. In the last run, `extraer` and `archivar` succeeded, `transformar` failed, and `publicar` did not run because of that failure. After fixing the code, the data engineer starts a repair run with the default selection.

Which tasks run again?
opciones: Only `transformar`, because it is the only task in a failed state
`transformar` and `publicar`: the failed task and the tasks that depend on it
All four tasks, because a repair run starts a new run of the entire job
`transformar`, `publicar`, and `archivar`, because they all depend directly or indirectly on `extraer`

job-21.enunciado:
An insurer uses Lakeflow Jobs to orchestrate a Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines pipeline (formerly Delta Live Tables) through a pipeline task, followed by a validation notebook that runs on a job cluster. An engineer asks which compute the pipeline update uses.

Which statement is correct?
opciones: The job cluster assigned to the validation notebook, because all tasks in a job share compute
A SQL warehouse, because pipeline tasks always run as SQL queries of the job
The all-purpose cluster of the engineer who created the job, because the pipeline inherits the owner's identity
The compute defined in the pipeline's own settings (serverless or classic), not a job cluster

job-22.enunciado:
A team of bank analysts maintains a saved query in the SQL editor that runs a MERGE on the `gold.saldos_diarios` table. They want it to run inside a job, immediately after the task that loads silver, without copying the SQL elsewhere and maintaining two versions.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: A SQL task of type query that uses the saved query, runs on a SQL warehouse, and depends on the silver load
A notebook with a %sql cell containing the MERGE, running on the same job cluster as the silver load
A SQL task that points to the saved query but runs on the classic job cluster used by the silver load
A dashboard task for the dashboard that uses `gold.saldos_diarios`, so the refresh runs the MERGE

job-23.enunciado:
The sales management team at a Peruvian retailer reviews an AI/BI dashboard with the previous day's sales. The gold table finishes loading at varying times between 3:00 and 6:00 a.m. The dashboard must refresh immediately after that load, and subscribers must receive the updated version.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Schedule the dashboard to refresh every day at 4:30 a.m. with its own schedule
Add a SQL alert task that notifies management when the gold table has new rows
Add a dashboard task to the job that depends on the gold load and has the subscribers configured
Add a notebook at the end of the job that queries the gold table and emails the results to management

job-24.enunciado:
An insurer's data team packages its code as a Python wheel named `aseguradora_etl`, which declares the entry point `cargar_polizas`. The team wants to run that function as a job task without creating intermediate notebooks.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: A Python script task that points directly to the .whl file, because the script runs the whole wheel
A Python wheel task with the package name `aseguradora_etl`, the entry point `cargar_polizas`, and the wheel as a library
A notebook task that installs the wheel with %pip install and imports the function in a cell
A pipeline task that uses the wheel as source code and runs `cargar_polizas` on every update

job-25.enunciado:
A telecom company's job has the job parameter `fecha_proceso` with the default value "2026-10-01". One of its notebook tasks also defines a task parameter with the same key, `fecha_proceso`, set to "2026-09-30".

When the job runs, which value does that task receive?
opciones: "2026-09-30", because the task parameter is more specific and always overrides the job parameter
None, because the job fails to start when a job parameter and a task parameter share a key
Both values, concatenated into a list that the notebook must split with dbutils.widgets.get
"2026-10-01", because when a job parameter and a task parameter share a key, the job parameter takes precedence

job-26.enunciado:
In the bundle for an insurance job, `ingesta_polizas` and `ingesta_siniestros` depend on `preparar` and must run in parallel. The `consolidar` task must wait until both ingestion tasks finish.

Which `depends_on` configuration for `consolidar` meets this requirement?
opciones: depends_on with task_key: ingesta_polizas and task_key: ingesta_siniestros
depends_on with only task_key: ingesta_siniestros, because it is the last task defined in the file
depends_on with only task_key: preparar, because both ingestion tasks already depend on it
No depends_on, because Lakeflow Jobs runs tasks in the order they appear in the YAML

job-27.enunciado:
A bank's risk team owns and maintains the `calculo_provisiones` job. The accounting close job must run it as an intermediate step and continue with the following tasks only if it succeeds, without copying its tasks.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Copy the notebooks of `calculo_provisiones` into the close job as new tasks to control the dependencies
Schedule the close job one hour after `calculo_provisiones`, assuming it will have finished by then
Add a Run Job task that runs `calculo_provisiones` and make the following tasks depend on it
Configure a file arrival trigger on the log folder of `calculo_provisiones`

job-28.enunciado:
A bank in Lima needs a job to run Monday through Friday at 5:30 a.m. Peru time. The advanced schedule settings in Lakeflow Jobs use Quartz cron syntax.

Which configuration meets this requirement?
opciones: Expression "30 5 * * 1-5" with time zone America/Lima
Expression "0 30 5 ? * MON-FRI" with time zone America/Lima
Expression "0 30 5 ? * MON-FRI" with time zone UTC
Expression "0 5 30 ? * MON-FRI" with time zone America/Lima

job-29.enunciado:
An insurance broker uploads a batch of about 40 files to a Unity Catalog volume every night, one at a time, over roughly 10 minutes. The job uses a file arrival trigger and currently starts on the first file, processing an incomplete batch. The job must run once, after the batch is complete.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Limit the job's concurrent runs to 1 so that the remaining files wait for the first run
Set a minimum time between triggers of 10 minutes to space out the job's runs
Switch to a table update trigger that points to the volume path where the files arrive
Configure the trigger to wait a period after the last file change, for example 15 minutes

job-30.enunciado:
A job with a file arrival trigger processes reports that a network of branches drops into a volume. The notebook reads the whole folder with spark.read on every run, so it reloads old files and creates duplicates. Each run must process only the new files.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Use Auto Loader with a checkpoint and the availableNow trigger inside the notebook that the job runs
Read, in the notebook, the list of new files that the file arrival trigger passes as a parameter
Configure a wait period after the last change so the trigger groups all the files
Replace the trigger with an hourly schedule so each run picks up only that hour's files

job-31.enunciado:
At an insurer, the job that builds `gold.rentabilidad` joins `silver.primas` and `silver.siniestros`, which two different teams update at varying times overnight. The job currently runs on a 6:00 a.m. cron schedule, and on some days it processes one of the tables before it has been updated. The job must run once, after both tables have been updated.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: A table update trigger on both tables with the condition that any of them has been updated
A file arrival trigger on the storage location that holds the files of both tables
A table update trigger on both tables with the condition that all of them have been updated
Move the cron schedule to 9:00 a.m. to give both teams more time before the gold table is built

job-32.enunciado:
A fintech in Brazil has a streaming job that processes transactions for fraud detection. The job must always be running: if a run finishes or fails, a new one must start automatically without any schedule, and two runs must never overlap.

Which trigger type meets these requirements?
opciones: A cron schedule every minute with a maximum of 1 concurrent run
A continuous trigger
A file arrival trigger on the checkpoint path
A table update trigger on the transactions table

cic-01.enunciado:

opciones: databricks bundle generate job --existing-job-id <id>
databricks bundle init --from-job <id>
databricks jobs export <id> --format yaml
databricks bundle deploy --import-job <id>

cic-02.enunciado:
Before deploying a bundle, a data engineer wants to verify that its configuration is valid, including syntax, references, and variables, without creating or modifying anything in the workspace.

Which command should the data engineer run?

databricks bundle run
databricks bundle init
databricks bundle destroy

cic-03.enunciado:

Which command deploys the bundle's resources to the production environment?
opciones: databricks bundle deploy -t prod
databricks bundle run -t prod
databricks bundle init prod
databricks jobs create --target prod

cic-04.enunciado:
In dev, the jobs must write to the `dev_seguros` catalog, and in prod to `prod_seguros`, using the same code.

How should the data engineer handle this in a bundle?
opciones: Define a `catalogo` variable, set its value in each target, and reference it as ${var.catalogo}
Maintain two Git branches with the catalog name hardcoded in each
Use a widget and change its value manually after each deployment
Create two identical bundles, one per environment

cic-05.enunciado:
Several developers deploy the same bundle to the development workspace. Their resources must not collide with one another, and the job schedules must not be activated.

What should the data engineer configure in the dev target?

mode: production
A separate workspace for each developer
Disable Git in the Git folders

cic-06.enunciado:
A teammate merged changes into the repository's main branch. A data engineer has main checked out in a Databricks Git folder and wants to see those changes.

What should the data engineer do?
opciones: Pull from the Git folder
Push from the Git folder
Create a new branch
Clone the repository again into a new folder

cic-07.enunciado:
From a Git folder, a data engineer committed and pushed the branch `feature/kpi-cobranzas`. The GitHub repository protects `main`: every change must go through a pull request approved by another person.

What is the next step to integrate the change?
opciones: Open a pull request from `feature/kpi-cobranzas` into `main` so it can be reviewed and approved before the merge
Switch to `main` in the Git folder, merge the branch locally, and push to `main`
Share the notebook with Can Edit permission so the other person can approve it in the workspace
Create a Lakeflow Jobs task that merges the branch when the notebook runs without errors

cic-08.enunciado:
A data engineering team wants a GitHub Actions pipeline to deploy the bundle to production automatically whenever a change is merged into main.

What is the recommended approach?
opciones: Run `databricks bundle deploy -t prod` in the pipeline, authenticated as a service principal
Store an engineer's personal access token in the repository code
Have someone import the notebooks manually after each merge
Rely on the production Git folder to update itself

cic-09.enunciado:
At an insurer in Lima, a data engineer works on the `feature/tarifas-auto` branch in a Git folder. When the data engineer brings the changes from `main` into the branch, Databricks reports a conflict in the `calculo_prima.py` notebook, which the data engineer and a colleague both changed on the same lines. Both people's work must be kept, and the integration must be completed without leaving Databricks.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Reset the branch to discard the local changes and rewrite them manually after the pull
Force push the local version of the notebook so it replaces the one in `main` in the remote repository
Edit the conflicting file in the Git folder, mark it as resolved, and complete the merge with a commit and push
Create a second Git folder with `main`, copy the notebook manually between them, and delete the original Git folder

cic-10.enunciado:
The tech lead at a bank in Bogotá requires that everything the team builds be version-controlled. An analyst believes that committing from a Git folder stores in Git the notebooks, the job configured in the Lakeflow Jobs UI, and the data in the silver table the analyst created.

Which statement correctly describes what is version-controlled?
opciones: Only the files in the Git folder, such as notebooks and YAML; neither the UI job nor the table data
The notebooks and also the UI job, because Databricks stores the job in Git when it is linked to a notebook in the Git folder
The notebooks, the job, and a copy of the silver table in Delta format inside the remote repository
Only the UI job and its parameters; the notebooks are stored in the workspace but not in the repository

cic-11.enunciado:
At a retailer in Santiago, a data engineer must add a validation to the inventory notebook. The team requires that nothing reach `main` without another person's review and that all work be done through the Databricks Git integration.

Which sequence follows this workflow?
opciones: Edit the notebook on `main` from the Git folder, commit and push, and request a review after deployment
Create a branch, commit without pushing, and ask a teammate to review the notebook directly in the Git folder
Pull `main`, edit the notebook, push to `main`, and open a pull request to record the change
Create a branch in the Git folder, commit and push, open a pull request into `main`, and merge after approval

cic-12.enunciado:
At a telecom company in Quito, a data engineer tries to create a Git folder from one of the company's private GitHub repositories, but the clone fails with an authentication error. The repository must remain private.

Which option resolves the problem?
opciones: Make the repository public during the clone and private again after it completes
Link Git credentials (a personal access token or the GitHub app) in the user settings and clone again
Request membership in the workspace admins group, because only admins can clone private repositories
Store the GitHub token in a workspace notebook so that the Git folder can read it during the clone

cic-13.enunciado:
A bank in Lima defines its bundle as shown. A data engineer runs `databricks bundle deploy` first with the `dev` target and then with `-t test`.

Which value does `${var.catalogo}` resolve to in each deployment?
opciones: dev: `dev_banca`; test: `test_banca`
dev: `dev_banca`; test: `dev_banca`, because the default value always takes precedence
dev: `prod_banca`; test: `test_banca`, because the last value defined in the file is used

cic-14.enunciado:
At an insurer in Guayaquil, each pull request deploys the bundle to the `test` target, but into its own schema (for example, `pr_482`) so that tests do not overwrite one another. The bundle already declares the `esquema` variable. The value must be set from the CI pipeline without modifying `databricks.yml`.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: `databricks bundle deploy -t test -p esquema=pr_482`
Add a new target named `pr_482` to `databricks.yml` on each pull request
`databricks bundle deploy -t test --var="esquema=pr_482"`
`databricks bundle deploy -t pr_482`, because the target name is assigned to the variable

cic-15.enunciado:
At a retailer in Arequipa, the `qa` target is shared by the whole team. Every job and pipeline deployed to `qa` must have the `[qa] ` prefix in its name, have its schedules paused, and carry the tag `ambiente: qa`, without repeating this configuration on each resource.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Use `mode: development` in `qa`, which adds the `[qa] ` prefix to resource names and pauses schedules
Set `mode: test` in `qa`, the mode intended for shared test environments
Override the name, schedule, and tags of each job and pipeline inside the `qa` target

cic-16.enunciado:
At a bank in Mexico City, production jobs must run with the identity of a service principal rather than that of the person or pipeline that deploys the bundle.

What should the data engineer add at the marked location in the `prod` target?
opciones: `permissions:` with the service principal and the `CAN_MANAGE` level on each job
`run_as:` with `service_principal_name` set to the service principal's application ID
`variables:` with `usuario: <application-id>`, referenced in each task
`workspace:` with `host:` set to the service principal's application ID

cic-17.enunciado:
At a supermarket chain in Lima, the bundle defines a Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipeline and a job that must run it. The pipeline ID is different in dev, test, and prod, because the pipeline is created on each deployment.

Which value should the data engineer set for `pipeline_id` so the same code works in every target?
opciones: `ventas` (the pipeline's `name` field)
The ID shown for the pipeline in the dev workspace, copied into the YAML
`${resources.pipelines.ventas_pipeline.id}`
`${var.pipeline_id}`, with the dev ID as the default value

cic-18.enunciado:
At an insurer in Santiago, the bundle's `databricks.yml` contains the section shown. A team member added the claims job in `jobs/siniestros.job.yml`, but after deployment the job does not appear in the workspace and `databricks bundle validate` does not list it.

Which option fixes the problem?
opciones: Move the file to `resources/` or add its path to the `include` list
Rename the file to `databricks.yml` so the CLI recognizes it
Run `databricks bundle deploy` with `--force`, which reads every YAML file in the project
Create the job in the Lakeflow Jobs UI and run `databricks bundle deploy` again

cic-19.enunciado:
At a bank in Lima, the production reconciliation job is deployed with a bundle from CI after every merge into `main`. An operator increased the number of workers in the job's cluster from the UI, and the change disappeared after the next deployment. The adjustment must be permanent.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Reapply the change in the Lakeflow Jobs UI after every production deployment
Remove the job from the bundle so that deployments no longer modify it
Disable the CI pipeline and manage the production job only from the UI
Change the workers in the bundle configuration and merge the change into `main` through a pull request

cic-20.enunciado:
At a telecom company in Lima, the CI pipeline deploys the bundle to `test` and must then run the integration tests job, defined as shown, and wait for its result.

Which command meets this requirement?
opciones: `databricks bundle run -t test "Pruebas de integración - tarifas"`
`databricks bundle run -t test pruebas_integracion`
`databricks bundle deploy -t test --run pruebas_integracion`
`databricks jobs run-now pruebas_integracion`

cic-21.enunciado:
At a retailer in Medellín, each pull request deploys the bundle to an ephemeral test target. When the pull request is closed, the CI pipeline must delete the jobs, pipelines, and files that the deployment created in the workspace, with no manual intervention.

Which option meets this requirement?
opciones: Delete the local `.databricks` folder on the CI runner when the pipeline finishes
Run `databricks bundle validate` against the ephemeral target to clean up its resources
Run `databricks bundle destroy` against the ephemeral target with `--auto-approve`
Delete each job from the Lakeflow Jobs UI at the end of the week

cic-22.enunciado:
A data team at an insurer in Lima is starting a new project from scratch. The team wants a standard structure with `databricks.yml`, folders for resources and code, and preconfigured dev and prod targets, so it can be version-controlled from day one.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Run `databricks bundle init` and choose a template, such as `default-python`
Run `databricks bundle generate job` to create the project structure
Export a workspace folder with `databricks workspace export-dir`
Create an empty repository and run `databricks bundle validate` to generate the files

cic-23.enunciado:
At a bank in Asunción, a GitHub Actions workflow must run `databricks bundle deploy -t prod` after every merge into `main`. Security requires that no personal credentials and no interactive steps be used.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Store the tech lead's personal access token in GitHub secrets and expose it as `DATABRICKS_TOKEN`
A service principal with OAuth M2M, with `DATABRICKS_HOST`, `DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID`, and `DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET` stored as secrets
Run `databricks auth login` in the workflow so a browser opens and a person approves the access
Write the service principal's client ID and secret in the `workspace` section of `databricks.yml`

OPTIMIZE
ANALYZE TABLE
REFRESH TABLE

In the Spark UI, an aggregation stage shows high "Spill (Disk)" values for most of its tasks.

opt-03.enunciado:

Add more workers to the cluster

opt-04.enunciado:

Where should the data engineer look first to find the cause, such as insufficient cloud instance capacity or a failing init script?

The Spark UI
The SQL warehouse query history
Unity Catalog lineage

opt-05.enunciado:
After the latest version of a library is installed on a cluster, a job starts failing with version conflict errors in a dependency that Databricks Runtime also uses.

What should the data engineer do?
opciones: Pin a version of the library that is compatible with the cluster's Databricks Runtime version
Always install the latest version of every dependency
Restart the cluster without changing anything
Increase the driver's memory

opt-06.enunciado:
A platform team manages hundreds of Unity Catalog managed tables and does not want to schedule OPTIMIZE and VACUUM manually for each one.

Which feature addresses this requirement?
opciones: Predictive optimization
Auto Loader
A job that runs VACUUM with a 0-hour retention
Delta Sharing

opt-07.enunciado:
A data engineer suspects that a daily job has become slower over the past few weeks.

How can the data engineer confirm this quickly?
opciones: Review the job's run history in Lakeflow Jobs and compare the current duration with previous runs
Review today's cluster event log
Run DESCRIBE HISTORY on any table
Review Unity Catalog lineage

opt-08.enunciado:
A bank reconciliation job with 6 tasks used to take about 25 minutes, but for the past week it has taken more than 70. The data engineer must identify which task causes the increase and in which run it started, without running anything again.

Which option meets these requirements?
opciones: Open the Spark UI for today's run and identify the slowest stage
Review the event log of the cluster used in the job's latest run
Rerun the job with twice as many workers and compare the duration
